template.name: Kestrel - HR Service Delivery Platform (sample)
template.summary: Kestrel, a 6,500-employee manufacturer with 4 plants and a head office, wants a cloud HR service delivery platform: employee self-service portal, HR case management with SLAs, a policy knowledge base, and integration with SAP SuccessFactors and Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on.
requirements: Employee portal usable by office and frontline (plant) employees
HR case management with SLA tracking and escalation
Integration with SAP SuccessFactors HRIS and Microsoft Entra ID SSO
India data residency and DPDP Act 2023 compliance
Go-live across all sites within about 5 months
Three-year total cost of ownership with clear assumptions

criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.description: Architecture, integrations, scalability and overall technical fit to the requirement.
criteria.industry_benchmark: Cloud-native platform with certified HRIS connectors, open REST APIs, SSO/SCIM, 99.9%+ availability and proven load testing at several times the client's headcount.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.description: Timeline, milestones, staffing, governance and risk/mitigation plan.
criteria.industry_benchmark: Phased plan with dated milestones and exit criteria, named team, pilot before roll-out, RAID log and hypercare; typical HR service delivery go-live is 12-20 weeks.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.description: Pricing clarity, total cost of ownership, stated assumptions and exclusions.
criteria.industry_benchmark: Transparent 3-year TCO, fixed-price or milestone-linked implementation, price locks, and all assumptions and exclusions stated - no open-ended estimates.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.description: Security controls, certifications (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2), data privacy and auditability.
criteria.industry_benchmark: Current ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II, encryption at rest and in transit, local data residency, DPDP/GDPR processes, MFA, immutable audit logs and independent penetration testing.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.description: Support model and SLAs, similar past projects and client references.
criteria.industry_benchmark: 24x7 P1 support with response SLAs and service credits, a customer success manager, and several referenceable implementations of similar size and industry.

formulas.Absolute weighted score: sum((criterion score / max score) x weight) -> 0-100
formulas.Criterion benchmark: highest validated score for the criterion across evaluated suppliers
formulas.Criterion gap: supplier score - benchmark (0 for the leader, otherwise negative)
formulas.Relative performance %: supplier score / benchmark x 100 (0 for everyone if the benchmark is 0)
formulas.Peer Performance Index (PPI): sum(relative % x weight) / sum(weights) -> used for ranking
formulas.Industry Alignment Index: sum((industry score / max score) x weight) -> 0-100, shown alongside
formulas.Tie-break order: 1) higher PPI 2) earlier submission date 3) higher experience rating 4) supplier name A-Z
